modules.title: Islamic Business Ethics & Finance
modules.description: Understanding Islamic business ethics, Sharia-compliant finance principles, halal certification, and their practical implications for business in Muslim-majority markets.
learningObjectives: Apply core Islamic business ethics: trust, fairness, and social responsibility
Understand Sharia compliance in financial products and transactions
Navigate halal business practices and certification requirements
Engage respectfully with Islamic finance principles
modules.audience: Business professionals operating in GCC and Muslim-majority markets

modules.title: UAE Labour Law & Employment Compliance
modules.description: Comprehensive UAE Labour Law compliance training covering MOHRE regulations, employment contracts, leave entitlements, and end-of-service gratuity.
learningObjectives: Apply UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 (Labour Law) requirements
Manage employment contracts, termination, and gratuity
Administer leave entitlements correctly
Navigate NAFIS Emiratisation requirements
modules.audience: HR and managers in UAE operations

modules.title: Saudi Arabia Vision 2030 & Business Transformation
modules.description: Understanding Vision 2030's transformation of Saudi Arabia's economy, diversification initiatives, and the opportunities for businesses in KSA's evolution.
learningObjectives: Understand Vision 2030's strategic pillars and economic targets
Identify business opportunities in Saudi Arabia's priority sectors (tourism, entertainment, fintech)
Navigate NEOM and Giga-project business development
Meet Saudization (Nitaqat) workforce requirements
modules.audience: Business development, strategy, and HR teams in KSA

modules.title: Arabic Business Communication
modules.description: Business Arabic essentials for non-Arabic speaking professionals, covering greetings, meeting etiquette, relationship-building, and understanding Arabic communication styles.
learningObjectives: Use essential business Arabic greetings and phrases
Navigate the relationship-first (wasta) business culture
Understand indirect communication norms in Arabic culture
Conduct effective meetings with Arab colleagues and clients
modules.audience: International professionals working in the Middle East

modules.title: GCC Workplace Diversity & Expatriate Management
modules.description: Managing the extraordinarily diverse GCC workforce — expatriates from 150+ nationalities alongside nationals — for cohesion, inclusion, and high performance.
learningObjectives: Build inclusive practices for highly diverse expatriate and national workforces
Navigate Emiratisation/Saudization policies and their team impact
Manage cultural differences across South Asian, Arab, Western, and national employees
Support expatriate integration and transition
modules.audience: HR and managers in GCC operations

modules.title: Ramadan & Religious Observance at Work
modules.description: Practical guidance for managers and employees on navigating Ramadan and other Islamic religious observances in the workplace with respect and inclusion.
learningObjectives: Understand the significance and practices of Ramadan for Muslim employees
Adapt work schedules and expectations during Ramadan
Observe respectful behavior during Islamic religious periods
Support Muslim colleagues' prayer and fasting obligations

modules.title: Anti-Money Laundering in MENA
modules.description: AML/CFT compliance training aligned with FATF requirements and MENA region regulatory frameworks including CBUAE, SAMA, and QCB regulations.
learningObjectives: Apply AML/CFT controls in MENA financial operations
Conduct Enhanced Due Diligence for high-risk customers in MENA
Understand Hawala and informal value transfer monitoring
File STRs with MENA FIUs appropriately
modules.audience: Financial services, legal, and compliance professionals

modules.title: Turkey Business Culture
modules.description: Business culture training for Turkey — bridging Eastern and Western influences, managing hierarchies, and building relationships in Turkey's unique business environment.
learningObjectives: Navigate Turkey's blend of formal hierarchy and warm hospitality
Understand the role of personal relationships in Turkish business
Adapt to Turkish decision-making and negotiation styles
Engage with Turkey's business practices across Istanbul, Ankara, and Anatolia

modules.title: NEOM & Future Cities — Digital Upskilling
modules.description: Digital skills training for professionals involved in Saudi Arabia's NEOM and future city projects — AI, smart city technology, and digital infrastructure.
learningObjectives: Understand smart city technology platforms and architecture
Apply AI and IoT in urban infrastructure management
Manage digital twin projects
Lead digital transformation in mega-project environments
modules.audience: Technology and project professionals in KSA mega-projects

modules.title: Gender in the Middle East Workplace
modules.description: Navigating gender dynamics in rapidly changing Middle Eastern workplaces, particularly supporting women's growing participation in GCC and Levant economies.
learningObjectives: Understand changing gender norms and legal reforms in GCC countries
Support women's advancement in Middle Eastern workplace contexts
Manage mixed-gender teams in culturally sensitive environments
Comply with gender-related labor regulations across MENA
modules.audience: Managers and HR professionals in MENA

modules.title: Israel Technology & Innovation Ecosystem
modules.description: Understanding the Israeli startup nation ecosystem, chutzpah culture, and how to partner effectively with Israeli tech companies and research institutions.
learningObjectives: Navigate Israel's flat, direct, and chutzpah-driven work culture
Understand the Israeli defense tech to commercial tech transfer pipeline
Build partnerships with Israeli startups and VCs
Manage working with Israeli teams across time zones and cultures

modules.title: Qatar Compliance & FIFA World Cup Legacy
modules.description: Qatar labor law compliance, including significant reforms introduced around the FIFA World Cup 2022, kafala system changes, and workers' rights improvements.
learningObjectives: Apply post-2020 labor law reforms in Qatar
Navigate the reformed kafala sponsorship system
Meet Qatarization workforce requirements
Ensure migrant worker rights and welfare standards
modules.audience: HR and operations teams in Qatar

modules.title: Healthcare Sector Training — MENA
modules.description: Healthcare sector-specific L&D for MENA professionals covering HAAD/DHA licensing, patient rights, and healthcare delivery standards.
learningObjectives: Apply UAE HAAD and DHA healthcare licensing requirements
Uphold patient rights and informed consent standards
Navigate clinical governance in MENA healthcare settings
Deliver culturally sensitive healthcare to diverse MENA populations
modules.audience: Healthcare professionals in UAE and MENA

modules.title: Sustainability & Green Economy in MENA
modules.description: ESG training aligned with UAE Net Zero 2050, Saudi Green Initiative, and broader MENA sustainability commitments including COP28 outcomes.
learningObjectives: Understand MENA countries' net-zero commitments and strategies
Apply UAE ESG reporting guidelines for listed companies
Implement green economy practices in MENA operations
Navigate renewable energy transition in oil-dependent economies
